import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    
    used = [False] * p
    t = 0
    
    def dfs(x):
        used[x] = True
        to = (x * k) % p
        if not used[to]:
            dfs(to)
    
    for i in range(p):
        if not used[i]:
            t += 1
            dfs(i)
    
    MOD = 10**9 + 7
    ans = 1
    for i in range(1, t + (1 if k == 1 else 0)):
        ans = (ans * p) % MOD
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
